reviews.text: [b] 现阶段最要害的是游戏性问题 [/b] 对于一个Roguelike游戏来说，现在的gameplay太匮乏了，不管什么地图战斗体验都高度相似，打起来如同喝白水。 一些个人建议： 1.提高地图随机性与地图深度（捷克刺猬，龙牙，铁丝网，雷区；地形起伏） 2.更多的敌人种类与机制（比如侦察车，堡垒炮，迫击炮车，歌莉娅自爆车，装甲抢修车，撞击虎） 3.敌人ai区分（比如高机动敌人倾向于绕侧，火炮类敌人会伏击或者尽量远离玩家） 4.ai之间的兵种组合和配合（以战斗群/小队与玩家交战而不是单车侠xN，战法牧组合） 5.敌人刷新方式优化，先把固定刷新点改了吧 6.地图目标优化，现在的目标有些简陋了（比如占领模式，敌人应该给D点布置一些防御工事） 7.更好的BOSS，现在的BOSS就是超级杂兵，是否可以给BOSS一些技能（烟雾弹/s雷/可规避的弹幕射击），或者被动（战斗续行/刚毅），甚至二阶段（KV6爆出几辆kv） 8.地图因子（[spoiler]飞弹大战，短视症，拿钱说话，焦土政策，扫雷专家，震荡攻击之类的 [/spoiler]） 9.低级武器需要一点爱，由于他们的基础数值太低，所以需要一些强化补正，甚至是一些perk，bd的帮助 10.现在的BD系统太简陋了，数量也很少，perk还是要让玩家做一些抉择和取舍比较好吧 11.武器类型之间需要平衡（如机枪现在就是丐版机炮，能否给机枪一些特效，比如压制敌人标记敌人） 12.更有深度的坦克升级，车体改装，强化可视化 13.添加炮塔轮盘，数字键切换炮塔 14.添加一些更多类型的炮塔，比如技能类的带电台可以呼叫火炮支援或者斯图卡，曲射炮塔，磷烟雾弹等等 15.拓展一下异常效果，例如击晕硬直，或者成员受伤和载具部件受损导致的异常效果（包括对敌我双方，但是要对玩家宽容一点） 16.玩家堆防护的收益有些低，无论5甲还是20甲被击穿都是同样的伤害，不符合直觉，能否根据装甲厚度提供一些减伤（剩余穿深机制），此外削甲机制也需要重新斟酌，玩家不应该和敌人杂兵套用同一套削甲模型 17.关卡之间的事件过于单调，需要更有趣的特殊事件 18.关卡中需要更多的随机掉落物

Game seems to be all over the place. The vehicles ranges from FT-17 to Post War Tanks that were never built, several Nationalities are represented, and an effort has been made to include most of the Multi turreted designs ever made. Very little effort has gone into the Maps which are small and not very detailed. Combat takes place at very short range, with very slow target tracking so that you can evade rounds by deft driving. I'd estimate the range of a 105mm Gun to be under forty feet in the game. You start with one tank and unlock others by grinding. There are some decent tanks and some interesting light vehicles but the level of fun is so low it feels like work and I'm about to give up. Steering is janky, the upgrade system is beyond my comprehension and in mission upgrades are random ranging from very useful to near useless. There's issues with balance, no attempt at realism, currently no cards or achievements. Its another budget game where enough had been done months ago, and adding stuff is not really going to make it any more interesting. Plenty of people like it, most of the reviews are positive, I just don't think its any good myself. Worth considering if you see it on Sale or like the Artwork.

哈哈。。我只能说这游戏毫无平衡性可言哈哈。。 最好用的是各路机炮，次之的是各路高爆弹，其他低于8级的穿甲弹都是给自己找不自在。 先说机炮吧，作者你是不是对穿深有什么误解啊？球状闪电在现实里用的是两联装的莱茵金属MK103，30mm口径的，这玩意儿原来是给战斗机设计的，300米距离可以打穿75-95mm的垂直装甲。游戏里呢？我们先不说纸面穿深多少，没有任何一台车包括但不限于老鼠T95土龟等等能挡住它的扫射，这合理吗？你觉得合理吗？你要知道老鼠除开头皮之外最薄的地方都有120mm了解一下？ 唉，真是一言难尽，用了机炮就回不去了，甭管啥车就无脑一路机炮即可，各路快车堆点装甲，各路慢车堆点机动，就这样了。 高爆弹呢也是离谱得很，由于可以无限堆装填速度，所以M12的155炮也可以堆到差不多3-4秒一炮，这玩意儿的数据我也不知道是怎么计算的，反正一打一片，一炮带走两三个老鼠什么的也是常有的。 然后现实主流的穿甲弹反而最鸡肋，既不能群攻也没有高射速。这也都算了，穿甲弹反而是最难打死敌人的，连火箭弹都可以无脑击穿，穿甲弹有可能好几炮打不死敌人（别跟我说什么绕后打侧面的，2011年入坑的WOT老玩家了，这谁不懂啊）所以说低级别的穿甲弹简直毫无游戏性和体验感，用穿甲弹纯粹是跟自己过不去。 作者改改吧，爆米花游戏你也不能把数值做得这么儿戏吧。

This game is fun almost very fun. But in its current state if you are looking for a fleshed out game this is not it. I do recognize that it is an early access game but for 8 dollars I would not suggest it in its current state. The price point I would put this game at is around 5-6 dollars. IF YOU HAVE THE MONEY TO SPARE DEFINITELY SUPPORT THE DEVELOPER BY BUYING THIS GAME!!! Impressive game for being their first game. THE GOOD This game and its future is very bright from the looks of the road map this year. THE MEH The game has about 4 maps and lots of vehicles that all perform about the same. The rougelike elements need to be fleshed out tremendously as almost every play through feels the same. The game has 3 bosses that are very frustrating to fight (might just be a me problem though) there is very little incentive to kill the boss rather than just avoid it all together. No sense of achievement at the end of a run would like to see some more sense of progression via stats or a score system leader board thing, ether tied to tanks or at the end of a run. END I will most likely change my review on this game in about three months.

一般般的游戏内容和贫瘠玩法，不算很肉鸽，甚至很牢，完全没有达到肉鸽的加成提升爽度；词条特性机制多样少，来来去去都是那么几个加装甲和移速的词条。稍微好一点就是自动主炮射击，装填缩短什么的 操作别扭，在没有词条数值选择加成下，移动操作非常的唐。 竟然作者你要选定以肉鸽为核心底子来扩展后面的开发玩法。那就好好深耕什么是肉鸽（不管是lite.还是like）；栗子很多，肉鸽幸存者那种的 土豆兄弟，还是什么哈迪斯.尖塔之类的；卡牌肉鸽你是仿照学到了一个关卡路线选择。没学到肉鸽词条机制以及后期的加成反馈，越往后敌人越来越强，而词条还是那重复的几样。装备道具加成？我是没感觉到有什么特别明显提升，可以说没有。升级加的词条数值没有提示明显，甚至就一丁点不同不痒的数值。 所谓的多炮塔，仅仅只是独一类，其他类坦克装甲，不能上，甚至没有机枪副炮，就一个主炮。甚至没有改造在额外加一个炮塔的格子。局外成长也没有。就只能打点小钱，买些坦克。然而收益很低，路线关卡的杂货店还会扣除这一部分收益。这也就说明到了肉鸽深度不行，选择词条，没有对金钱收益加成，没有更好的对其他额外加成变化改造.人物角色词条特性也是没有太多的肉鸽性。 看似很多坦克，可能就有几个能玩的。 问题实在太多，说明不上来，只有一肚子槽水{甚至没有了试玩版那种觉得好玩的感觉}。 我不知道后面未来还会不会有其他玩法模式。但就看这开发方向和产能。只能祝大卖吧。 我没法给什么建议，你作者自己做的游戏，有自己的想法。说多没啥用，爱玩玩，不喜欢就退。现在都这逼样的环境。 就目前暂时不是很推荐，折扣白菜史地价20以内可以考虑？就现在的贫瘠抢先体验和作者哪天突然最终摆烂停更。建议观望吧。 后面人想买来玩玩鲜的；如果只是想体验坦克，感觉很新鲜的肉鸽类坦克玩法？其实没必要。 被安东飞马bvvd搞心态也没必要来玩这个。 放下对抗游戏 看个番片缓解下心情（打个∠）；想雷瘾了，过几天在开一两把骂bvvd司马，有和不可呢。 我自己就不退款了。估计也超退款时间了（唉.国游抢先付费赤石游戏体验.真碰不得）。算是送给作者的一斤猪鸭鸡鱼肉钱+一两斤瓜果青菜钱了。

So, Game is mindless fun. Don't get me wrong there. But it just seems empty really. Once you do one run you've done them all. Sure you get different turrets, but in the end it's the same enemies, same bosses, same difficulty. I played with the Independent tank (A1E1) to level it up, and even as a tier 1 tank I wiped the floor on difficulty 5 (The highest at time of making). There are no modifiers to make it harder, there are no unique map conditions, etc. Sure, a non multi turret tank could make it harder but the game is called "Multi Turret Academy", why would I play a non-multi turret tank to make it harder. And the Academy part isn't really there. Just characters that have a few text messages then generic upgrades. The events are there but they are just meh. They need to hone in on the core gameplay loop and build out their theme. Once they do that then i can recommend it. Right now, I can't really.

Fun initially but very shallow and broken with no prospect of getting better even if it comes out of EA. You can use different types of ammo and guns like AP HE HEAT HVAP MG. But armor system is bad. Non-penetrating shots 'strip' armor. So instead of using the dedicated anti-armour guns with AP and APCR rounds, the meta is high rate-of-fire and explosive rounds (MG, HVAP, HE, Rocket). You can take down the biggest tank of WWII, the Maus, with a Machinegun. Because armor is so useless, the best tanks are the ones with more turrets so you can fit more of the OP guns on them. A Rank 1 (the lowest tier) multi-turret tank can win the game easily. A single turret tank like the Tiger I or IS-2 1944 is handicapped by only having a slow AP gun - and the armor they get counts for little since the enemy will just rush you with many small tanks firing machineguns and remove your armor. Most of the vehicles in the game are the single turret types - so that's most the vehicles in the game close to unplayable. Also any slow tank, which should be relying on armor, is useless because the only form of protection is mobility - speeding around the map dodging shots, while spamming off as many rounds as possible. There is a starting strategy system where you choose which bonuses to have active on your run - this is supposed to alter the playstyle you use - but the effects are so weak to the point of being meaningless. The roguelike upgrades you get on your run are also weak. You can get ally tanks but they are AI controlled useless bullet sponges. All the armor upgrades are ofc effectively useless. Most of the crew bonuses are useless, then there are a handful which are completely overpowered if you get them. When entering a fight you get to choose what kind of encounter it is. Raid and Capture have a pre-determined enemy count - you can clear the map then complete the objectives. Assault, Defend, and Survive mission types all spawn endless infinite enemies. So why would I ever choose the infinite ones if I want to win the run? I went to Discord to get some help understanding the game, but there is no help to be found. It's all tank-talk and people requesting to add new tanks. I can see how the game has so many vehicles in it which, while historically accurate, are not even viable to play the game with. Considering it's been over 2 years since this launched, and how the Dev is focussed on adding everyone's favourite tank into the game, I can't see the gameplay and balance issues being fixed.
